problem.description: Username field cannot be edited when modifying a user in the user management modal

visual_symptoms.symptom: Username field appears with light blue background indicating disabled/readonly state
Error message displayed above username field showing technical component details
Field is not accepting input from user

project_history.version: Made username field readonly during editing for security
Fixed email and password fields incorrectly appearing as readonly
Re-enabled username editing by removing readonly restriction
project_history.current_issue: Despite v3.9.3 changes, username field still not editable

technical_stack.error_indicator: Input component prop configuration issue visible in screenshot

hypothesis.primary: There may be conflicting or incorrect props being passed to the Input component for the username field
hypothesis.secondary: The readonly or disabled prop might still be set despite the v3.9.3 fix
hypothesis.tertiary: There could be a condition or logic error preventing the field from being editable

investigation_plan.step: Check username field Input component configuration
Verify prop passing and conditional logic
Check Input component implementation for prop handling
